name: carbon-arc-company-intelligence
description: Analyze companies and brands with Carbon Arc data. Built to keep you in control: iterate and explore as you normally would, or ask it to run straight through. Three reports: competitive insights for strategy teams, an earnings preview for investors, and a category report for small businesses. Try: "Build a competitive insights report on [company]." "Put together an earnings preview for [ticker]." "Where else do [company]'s customers spend?" "Measure the impact of [event] on [company]."
